item.title: Magnitude 2.5 Earthquake Reported Near Hillsboro in Southern Ohio
item.description: HILLSBORO, Ohio — A small earthquake was recorded Sunday morning in southern Ohio, just northeast of Hillsboro. According to the U.S. Geological Survey, the magnitude 2.5 quake occurred at 10:50 a.m. UTC (5:50 a.m. local time) approximately 3 kilometers (about 2.3 miles) northeast of Hillsboro.
